      "observations": [
        "All 119 owned paths and all 3,648 diff lines were read, including every changed test, shared helper, Calendar path and platform selector. This human functional port is not excluded by size. The separate read-boundary receipt preserves all eight contiguous ranges and exact diff SHA. B owns the preceding disabled port; none of its owned bodies were read.",
        "The port changes checked markup defaults from true strings to present empty attributes and removes false defaults. Producers use toggleAttribute/removeAttribute, consumers use hasAttribute, and CSS/test queries use [checked]. These are exact checked-path changes. selected/open/ARIA/value-bearing attributes have their own contracts and were not mechanically converted by this entry.",
        "Calendar toggles now consume toggleAttribute's Boolean return directly for orientation, workdays, task visibility and completed visibility. Their actual view setters store/update those values; modebox togglePane passes the same result to setVisible. The timezone test helper expects a Boolean field, and its inspected callers pass true/false, so the new presence comparison matches its input contract.",
        "Custom receivers retain separate state work. Gloda facets coordinate a host attribute, an actual HTML input.checked property and facet-constraint side effects. Tag filtering changes a menuitem attribute in one branch but a custom pressed property in another. The junk whitelist intentionally reads attributes because its local comment warns that properties can be unavailable or unreliable. A checked method name alone does not identify a universal DOM operation.",
        "UnifiedToolbarButton translates observed command presence into ariaPressed during connection and mutation. Its direct test checks explicit string false/true/false/false after adding/removing checked. The port does not replace ARIA with presence semantics, and these source assertions do not prove a live screen-reader or focus result.",
        "The Compose API now reads encryption-button presence with hasAttribute, matching the producer's toggleAttribute; the global is only a fallback for an absent button. Editor font style remains a value-bearing state string converted by theStyle === true-string. Existing focused Compose/folder-popup/toolbar/persistence findings are reused in their exact scope.",
        "All changed test hunks were read. Menu/helper expectations move from true/false strings to Boolean presence, negative checks stop accepting checked=false, column mutations wait on presence transitions, and menubar callbacks take Booleans. Existing menubar tests assert exact persisted sentinel/empty-string values and open new windows as a restart proxy; no test or restart ran.",
        "At least six changed assertion calls lack messages: the picker checked-state assertion, manual-reminder checked-state assertion and four spelling-language checked-state assertions. Inspected adjacent picker/reminder helper assertions and the draft-format assertion also lack messages. Several other messages omit should but remain non-empty; that wording alone is not treated as a defect.",
        "Two checked-state failure messages describe the wrong expected behavior: browser_feedBodyDisplay checks webPageItem true but says Summary should be selected; browser_sendFormat inserts not when its expected checked Boolean is true. Both mismatches remain in the exact accepted source. They are diagnostic-text findings, not evidence that the checked logic failed at runtime.",
        "The original ignore/watch helper sometimes forwards an optional-folder expression directly as the force argument. The accepted phase explicitly wraps those values in Boolean and targets menuitems. The separate 4343 command-target follow-up is later backed out. The accepted current source and shared Bug's beta/central phases must not be replaced by a claim that the first port survived unchanged.",
        "Manual style checks kept stable command/localization/stored names and read loops in their actual roles. The folder popup's retained comment still says before string although its body now toggles presence.
